# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  # renovate: datasource=conda depName=bioconda/svdss
  - bioconda::svdss=2.1.1

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process SVDSS_SEARCH {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/83/8357bb6a78ac936810ecc7528fa4b53a8deea7e7d8abb31afb8ed7e14a05fdc3/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/svdss:2.1.1--5e16609dd2159d4e'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reads)
    tuple val(meta2), path(index)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.sfs.txt"), emit: sfs
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('svdss'), eval("SVDSS --version 2>&1 | sed 's/SVDSS, v//'"), emit: versions_svdss, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def input_flag = reads.name.endsWith('.bam') ? '--bam' : '--fastx'
    """
    SVDSS search \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        --index ${index} \\
        ${input_flag} ${reads} \\
        ${args} \\
        > ${prefix}.sfs.txt
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch ${prefix}.sfs.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/svdss/search"
description: "Extract sample-specific strings (SFS) from reads with SVDSS by searching\
  \ them against an FM-index of the reference genome"
keywords:
- "structural variants"
- "sv calling"
- "sample-specific strings"
- "long reads"
- "fm-index"
tools:
- svdss:
    description: "Structural Variant Discovery from Sample-specific Strings."
    homepage: "https://github.com/Parsoa/SVDSS"
    documentation: "https://github.com/Parsoa/SVDSS/blob/v2.1.1/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/Parsoa/SVDSS"
    doi: "10.1038/s41592-022-01674-1"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:svdss"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reads:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reads in BAM format, ideally smoothed with SVDSS smooth, or in\
        \ FASTQ format (plain or gzip-compressed).\nFiles ending in `.bam` are passed\
        \ with `--bam`, all others with `--fastx`.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bam,fastq,fq,fastq.gz,fq.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - index:
      type: "file"
      description: "FM-index of the reference genome produced by SVDSS index"
      pattern: "*.{fmd,fmr}"
      ontologies: []
output:
  sfs:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.sfs.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Tab-separated list of sample-specific strings found in each\
          \ read"
        pattern: "*.sfs.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_svdss:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - svdss:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - SVDSS --version 2>&1 | sed 's/SVDSS, v//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - svdss:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - SVDSS --version 2>&1 | sed 's/SVDSS, v//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"

- "@krannich479"
maintainers:
- "@krannich479"
